The two systems side by side

ItemPrevious systemNew system
Applies toContributing before 3 July 2024First contribution from 3 July 2024
Average wageLast 24 monthsHighest wages over 180 months
Rate per year2.5% (months ÷ 480)2.25%
Normal age60 Hijri with 120 months (or the transitional table)65 Gregorian with 180 months
Early retirement300 months at any age, no reduction (300–360 for the transitional group)360 months and age 55, 3% reduction a year
Minimum pensionSAR 1,983.754,000 at 480 months, falling to 2,000 at 180

Examples with an average wage of SAR 10,000:
Previous system, 25 years (300 months) at any age: 10,000 × 300 ÷ 480 = SAR 6,250.
Previous system, 35 years at the normal age: SAR 8,750.
New system, 25 years at 65: 2.25% × 10,000 × 25 = SAR 5,625.
New system, early at 58 after 35 years: 7,875 less 15% = SAR 6,693.75.

To find your exact retirement date and when you complete the early-retirement period, use the Saudi retirement age calculator. Government employees under the civil retirement system have a different formula (last basic salary ÷ 480). Prefer Arabic? Use the Arabic version.

Frequently asked questions

How is the pension calculated under the previous system?

The average contributory wage of the last 24 months × the number of contribution months ÷ 480 — that is 2.5% for each year — up to 100% of the average and with a minimum of SAR 1,983.75. Example: average SAR 10,000 and 25 years = SAR 6,250.

How is the pension calculated under the new system?

For those first registered from 3 July 2024: 2.25% × the average of the highest wages over 180 months × years of contribution, up to 100%. The normal age is 65 with at least 180 months. Example: average SAR 10,000 and 25 years at 65 = SAR 5,625.

Did the retirement age change for existing members?

Yes, for those who on 3 July 2024 were under 50 Hijri years (48.5 Gregorian) and had fewer than 240 months: their normal age becomes between 58 years 4 months and 65, depending on their age that day, and early retirement needs 300 to 360 months depending on their service. The formula did not change. Those aged 50 Hijri or more, or with 240 months or more, keep the previous age and early-retirement rules.

Is there a reduction for early retirement?

Not under the previous system (including the transitional group). Under the new system early retirement needs 360 months and age 55, with a 3% reduction for every 12 months — the lower of the months left to 65 or the months short of 480.

Which wage is the pension based on?

The contributory wage: basic salary plus housing allowance, capped at SAR 45,000 a month. Other allowances such as transport are not included.

What if I don't qualify for a pension?

Under the previous system a lump-sum compensation is paid: 10% of the average wage for each of the first 60 months and 12% for each month after. Under the new system, those who do not reach 180 months by 65 are compensated on their total contributions.
